title: Police Union Executive Imported Thousands of Opioid Pills — Then Received Probation

claims.claim: The 2023 complaint alleged a long history of overseas pill shipments, at least 61 shipments stretching back to 2015.

supportingEvidence.text: Pleaded guilty to unlawfully importing tapentadol after investigators documented years of overseas pill shipments; prosecutors said she ordered roughly 18,000 tapentadol pills during a 17-month period in 2021 and 2022.
supportingEvidence.citation: Joanne Segovia - San Jose Police Officers' Association Opioid Importation — offense record

supportingEvidence.text: Prosecutors and defense both described addiction rather than profit as the central motive; The government credited her acceptance of responsibility, sobriety, and low risk of reoffending; Judge Eumi K.
